projects.title: Muhasib
projects.description: A family financial management system for tracking income, expenses and monthly budgets in one simple dashboard.
projects.descriptionPs: د کورنۍ مالي مدیریت سیستم چې عاید، لګښتونه او میاشتنۍ بودیجه په یو ساده ډشبورډ کې تعقیبوي.
projects.getting: you can get these application by below telegrame link

details.overview: Muhasib is a personal and family finance tracking system. It gives a household a single place to record income and expenses, categorise spending and see where the money actually goes each month.
details.problem: Families often track money in notebooks or scattered spreadsheets. There is no clear monthly picture, and small expenses are forgotten.
details.solution: A lightweight web application with quick entry forms, category breakdowns and a monthly summary view that works well on a phone.
features: Add and edit income and expense entries
Persian/Pashto friendly number and date display
details.challenges: Keeping the interface simple enough for daily use while still giving a useful financial overview. Handling number formatting correctly for RTL users was also a real design problem.
details.learned: How to structure a small data-driven application, how to design forms people actually finish, and how to keep financial data readable at a glance.

projects.title: خوږې او په زړه پورې کیسې
projects.titlePs: خوږې او په زړه پورې کیسې
projects.description: A Pashto stories application for reading short, sweet and engaging stories on mobile.
projects.descriptionPs: د پښتو کیسو اپلیکیشن چې لنډې او په زړه پورې کیسې لوستل کېږي.

details.overview: A mobile reading application that presents a curated collection of short Pashto stories in a clean, comfortable reading layout.
details.problem: Pashto reading content is scattered across social media posts and low-quality websites with poor typography and lots of ads.
details.solution: A distraction-free mobile reader with proper Pashto typography, adjustable text size and fast navigation between stories.
details.challenges: Pashto text rendering and line height needed careful tuning. Standard Android defaults produced cramped, hard-to-read paragraphs.
details.learned: Practical RTL typography on Android, layout work with long text content, and designing for comfortable reading.

projects.title: خوندور بیتونه
projects.description: A Pashto poetry application for browsing and reading selected verses.
projects.descriptionPs: د پښتو شعرونو اپلیکیشن د غوره بیتونو لوستلو لپاره.

details.overview: A poetry reading app that presents Pashto verses in a clean layout with poet attribution and simple browsing.
details.problem: Poetry lovers have to scroll through cluttered feeds to find verses, and there is no clean way to read or revisit favourites.
details.solution: A simple, focused reading experience with a clear typographic hierarchy for verse, poet and title.
details.challenges: Balancing poetic line structure with small screen widths without breaking the meaning of a verse.
details.learned: Working with structured content, text-heavy UI layout and RTL typography detail.

projects.title: ادبي ډیوه
projects.description: A literary content project for presenting Pashto literary writing in a clean, readable web layout.
projects.descriptionPs: ادبي محتوا پروژه چې پښتو ادبي لیکنې په پاک او لوستلو وړ وېب بڼه ښیي.

details.overview: Adabi Dewa is a content-focused project for publishing and reading Pashto literary material on the web.
details.problem: Literary Pashto content online is usually published in designs that are hard to read and impossible to browse.
details.solution: A typography-first reading layout with clear hierarchy, comfortable line length and full RTL support.
details.challenges: Getting Pashto line height, letter spacing and heading hierarchy to feel natural rather than mechanical.
details.learned: Deep practical work with CSS typography, writing modes and RTL layout.

projects.title: عبرتناکې او اسلامي کیسې
projects.description: An application presenting Islamic and moral stories with lessons, built for comfortable mobile reading.
projects.descriptionPs: اسلامي او عبرتناکې کیسې د درسونو سره، د موبایل په آرامه لوستلو لپاره.

details.overview: A mobile application that presents Islamic and moral stories together with the lesson each story carries.
details.problem: Readers want short, authentic moral content in a clean format without ads, popups or broken text.
details.solution: A simple reader with a story list, a detail screen, and a clearly separated lesson section under each story.
features: Story detail with a dedicated lesson section
details.challenges: Structuring content so the story and the lesson stay clearly separated without making the screen feel crowded.
details.learned: Content modelling for structured text, mobile reading layout, and building a clean offline experience.
